newsitem.title: GERMANY: Badenwerk first half operating profit up.
newsitem.headline: Badenwerk first half operating profit up.

text.p: German utility group Badenwerk AG said on Thursday that its group operating profit rose to 201.3 million marks from around 156.4 million marks in the first six months of the year.
Badenwerk said that the rise in earnings came despite a slight drop in turnover and was mostly attributable to lower electricity production costs and cheaper fuel prices.

"The figures are the optimal preparations for our merger with Schawaben AG (fellow utility Energie-Versorgung Schawaben -EVS). The merged company will be well positioned in the liberalised energy markets in Germany," management board spokesman, Gerhard Goll, said in a statement.
In the six months the group produced 27 percent more gas than in the previous year, Badenwerk said.
The statement said that Badenwerk and EVS would discuss the merger at shareholders' meetings on August 20.
